method: Opened the seven chapter reference targets and inspected relevant passages. Reused previously verified individual official sign captions/artwork with hash checks; this is not a claim that all individual sign pages were fetched again.

sources.finding: Official catalogue identifies sign families, signals, markings, police directions and guards. Retained approved individual caption/asset bindings; each placed example links to its own official description.

Chapter 3 §§3–15 supports steady vehicle indications, amber unsafe-stop exception, flashing amber, lane control and separate public-transport scope. Chapter 2 and marking captions retain the verified source-register meanings.

Current chapter 2 §§2–4 supports precedence. Chapter 3 §§5,7,9–11,14–20 supports yielding, lane choice, line restrictions, safe speed, defaults and keeping junctions clear. Chapter 9 §1 motorway defaults retained. Future unrelated amendments not applied.
Catalogue confirms supplementary panels give distance, extent, time and other qualifications. Exact official poster vectors retain reviewed minimum dimensions; no invented assembly.
Speed-and-impact guidance explains increased impact severity and shorter stopping distance at lower speed. No copied graphic or numerical injury model used.

VTI report 980, hosted by Transportstyrelsen, sections 4.2–4.3 supports reaction plus braking distance and the shared available friction for braking/steering. The 50/3.6 and 80/3.6 examples are explicitly hypothetical unit conversions, not braking predictions.
TSFS 2011:20 chapters 2–3 supports observation, margins, prediction, consequence assessment and reflection.
